The $150-200 Crude Oil longs:

Are about to get a taste of what the Silver paper price manipulation is like.

This time, it’s coming from the US Gov, not bullion banks/CME.

Per Financial Times:

“US Treasury was considering measures to lower oil prices, including intervention in futures markets.”

The speculation was that it could be from the US Treasury,” he added, noting that the government has previously intervened in other markets.

I would not position against the US government wanting to contain crude oil prices.
